bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to roads; eliminating a provision governing certain maintenance of closed or abandoned town roads; repealing Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 365.10, subdivision 11.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+REPEALER. +]

[+Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 365.10, subdivision 11,+]

[+ is repealed. +]

APPENDIX
Repealed Minnesota Statutes: 25-04610

365.10 ANNUAL TOWN MEETING; POWERS OF ELECTORS.

Subd. 11.
Abandoned town roads.
The electors may let the town board, by resolution, determine whether to open or maintain town roads or town cartways under the jurisdiction of the town board upon which no maintenance or construction has been conducted for 25 years or more. For purposes of this subdivision, section 163.16 does not apply to town roads described in this subdivision. This subdivision does not limit the right of town voters or land owners to petition to establish a cartway under section 164.08.
